title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Overview（净收入同比 +44%）
key_points: FY2022 净收入为 $23.6 billion，较 FY2021 的 $16.4 billion 增长 44%。
10-K 将收入增长归因于：Data Center 分部收入 +64%（主要因 EPYC 服务器处理器销量提升）、Gaming 分部 +21%（主要因半定制产品销量提升）、以及 Embedded 分部收入因并入 Xilinx embedded 产品销售而显著增长。
Client 分部收入下降 10%，主要因 PC 市场疲弱及 PC 供应链的大幅库存修正。
毛利率由 48% 降至 45%，10-K 明确主因是与 Xilinx 收购相关的无形资产摊销。
经营利润由 FY2021 的 $3.6 billion 降至 FY2022 的 $1.3 billion，10-K 明确主因是 Xilinx 收购相关无形资产摊销。
raw_excerpt: Net revenue for 2022 was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to 2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion. The increase in net revenue was driven by a 64% increase in Data Center segment revenue primarily due to higher sales of our EPYC™ server processors, a 21% increase in Gaming segment revenue primarily due to higher semi-custom product sales, and a significant increase in Embedded segment revenue from the prior year period driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product sales. This growth was partially offset by a 10% decrease in Client segment revenue ... Gross margin, as a percentage of net revenue for 2022, was 45%, compared to 48% in 2021. The decrease in gross margin was primarily due to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition. Operating income for 2022 was $1.3 billion compared to operating income of $3.6 billion for 2021. The decrease in operating income was primarily driven by amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Results of Operations: Client segment (p48)
key_points: Client FY2022 net revenue was $6.2 billion, a 10% decrease from $6.9 billion in FY2021.
The decrease was primarily driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipments, partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price.
The unit shipment decrease was attributed to challenging PC market conditions and significant inventory correction across the PC supply chain experienced during the second half of 2022.
The ASP increase was primarily driven by a richer mix of Ryzen mobile processor sales.
Client operating income fell to $1.2 billion in FY2022 from $2.1 billion in FY2021, driven by lower revenue and higher operating expenses.
raw_excerpt: Client net revenue of $6.2 billion in 2022 decreased by 10%, compared to net revenue of $6.9 billion in 2021, primarily driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipment, partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price. The decrease in unit shipments was due to challenging PC market conditions and significant inventory correction across the PC supply chain experienced during the second half of 2022. The increase in average selling price was primarily driven by a richer mix of Ryzen mobile processor sales.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Risk Factors: Client segment revenue decline (p19)
key_points: The filing states the Client segment revenue decline resulted from weak PC market macroeconomic conditions and inventory correction actions across the PC supply chain in the second half of 2022.
raw_excerpt: We experienced a decline in our Client segment revenue as a result of weak PC market macroeconomic conditions and inventory correction actions across the PC supply chain in the second half of 2022.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Segment net revenue and operating income table, FY2020–FY2022 (p48 / p68, Note 4)
key_points: All Other operating loss of $4,979 million in FY2022 included $3,548 million of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, $1,081 million of stock-based compensation, and $452 million of acquisition-related costs.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A: Data Center segment (p48)
key_points: Data Center net revenue was $6 billion in FY2022, up 64% from $3.7 billion in FY2021.
The increase was primarily driven by higher sales of EPYC server processors.
Data Center operating income rose to $1.8 billion from $991 million, driven by higher revenue partially offset by higher operating expenses.
raw_excerpt: Data Center net revenue of $6 billion in 2022 increased by 64%, compared to net revenue of $3.7 billion in 2021. The increase was primarily driven by higher sales of our EPYC server processors.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A: Gaming segment (p49)
key_points: Gaming net revenue was $6.8 billion in FY2022, up 21% from $5.6 billion in FY2021.
The increase was driven by higher semi-custom product sales due to higher demand for gaming console SoCs.
This was partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales due to a decrease in unit shipments driven by soft consumer demand given weakened macroeconomic conditions in the second half of 2022.
Gaming operating income was $953 million versus $934 million in FY2021.
raw_excerpt: Gaming net revenue of $6.8 billion in 2022 increased by 21%, compared to net revenue of $5.6 billion in 2021. The increase in net revenue was driven by higher semi-custom product sales due to higher demand for gaming console SoCs, partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales due to a decrease in unit shipments driven by soft consumer demand given weakened macroeconomic conditions experienced in the second half of 2022.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A: Embedded segment (p49)
key_points: Embedded net revenue was $4.6 billion in FY2022 versus $246 million in FY2021.
The increase was primarily driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue following the Xilinx acquisition completed in February 2022.
Embedded operating income was $2.3 billion versus $44 million in FY2021.
raw_excerpt: Embedded net revenue of $4.6 billion in 2022 increased significantly, compared to net revenue of $246 million in 2021. The significant increase in net revenue was primarily driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue as a result of the acquisition of Xilinx in February 2022.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Overview: total revenue growth and gross margin (p43)
key_points: FY2022 net revenue was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to FY2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion.
The filing attributes FY2022 results to the strength of a diversified business model despite challenging PC market conditions in the second half of 2022.
Gross margin was 45% in FY2022 versus 48% in FY2021, with the decrease primarily due to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.
FY2022 operating income was $1.3 billion versus $3.6 billion in FY2021; net income was $1.3 billion versus $3.2 billion.
raw_excerpt: Our 2022 financial results reflect the strength of our diversified business model despite the challenging PC market conditions in the second half of 2022. Net revenue for 2022 was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to 2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Segment reporting structure change (p48)
key_points: Effective Q2 of fiscal 2022, AMD changed its reporting segments to four reportable segments: Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded.
The change aligned financial reporting with how the CODM assesses performance and allocates resources.
raw_excerpt: During the second quarter of fiscal year 2022, we changed our reporting segments to align our financial reporting with how we manage our business in strategic end markets. ... we report our financial performance based on the following four reportable segments: Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded.

管理层称 2022 年业绩体现多元化业务模式的韧性，尽管 2022 年下半年 PC 市场环境严峻。
2022 年 2 月完成对 Xilinx 的收购，将可编程硬件平台纳入产品组合。

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Data Center 分部讨论（EPYC 驱动的服务器需求）
key_points: Data Center 营收 2022 年约 60 亿美元，同比 +64%（2021 年 37 亿美元）。
该增长主要归因于 EPYC 服务器处理器销量上升。
Data Center 经营利润由 2021 年 9.91 亿美元升至 2022 年 18.48 亿美元，主因营收增长，部分被运营费用增加抵消。
raw_excerpt: Data Center net revenue of $6 billion in 2022 increased by 64%, compared to net revenue of $3.7 billion in 2021. The increase was primarily driven by higher sales of our EPYC server processors. Data Center operating income was $1.8 billion in 2022, compared to operating income of $991 million in 2021.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Client 分部讨论（出货量 -24% 与 ASP +19%）
key_points: Client 营收 2022 年 62 亿美元，同比 -10%（2021 年 69 亿美元）。
下滑主要由出货量（unit shipment）下降 24% 造成，被平均售价（ASP）上升 19% 部分抵消。
出货量下降归因于 PC 市场环境严峻，以及 2022 年下半年 PC 供应链的大幅库存修正。
ASP 上升主要归因于 Ryzen 移动处理器销售结构（mix）更优。
Client 经营利润由 2021 年 20.88 亿美元降至 2022 年 11.90 亿美元，主因营收下降与运营费用上升。
raw_excerpt: Client net revenue of $6.2 billion in 2022 decreased by 10%, compared to net revenue of $6.9 billion in 2021, primarily driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipment, partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price. The decrease in unit shipments was due to challenging PC market conditions and significant inventory correction across the PC supply chain experienced during the second half of 2022. The increase in average selling price was primarily driven by a richer mix of Ryzen mobile processor sales.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Gaming 分部讨论（主机 SoC 需求 vs 显卡消费需求疲软）
key_points: Gaming 营收 2022 年 68 亿美元，同比 +21%（2021 年 56 亿美元）。
增长由半定制产品销售上升驱动，原因是游戏主机 SoC 需求增加。
增长部分被游戏显卡销售下降抵消，后者源于 2022 年下半年宏观环境走弱导致消费需求疲软、出货量减少。
Gaming 经营利润 9.53 亿美元（2021: 9.34 亿美元），增长主因营收上升，部分被运营费用增加抵消。
raw_excerpt: Gaming net revenue of $6.8 billion in 2022 increased by 21%, compared to net revenue of $5.6 billion in 2021. The increase in net revenue was driven by higher semi-custom product sales due to higher demand for gaming console SoCs, partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales due to a decrease in unit shipments driven by soft consumer demand given weakened macroeconomic conditions experienced in the second half of 2022.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Embedded 分部讨论（Xilinx 并表贡献）
key_points: Embedded 营收 2022 年 45.52 亿美元，2021 年仅 2.46 亿美元。
该显著增长主要归因于 2022 年 2 月完成 Xilinx 收购后并入 Xilinx 嵌入式产品营收。
Embedded 经营利润 22.52 亿美元（2021: 0.44 亿美元），增长主因并入 Xilinx 嵌入式产品营收。
raw_excerpt: Embedded net revenue of $4.6 billion in 2022 increased significantly, compared to net revenue of $246 million in 2021. The significant increase in net revenue was primarily driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue as a result of the acquisition of Xilinx in February 2022.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — 毛利率与 All Other 项目（Xilinx 摊销对利润的影响）
key_points: 毛利率由 2021 年 48% 降至 2022 年 45%，主因 Xilinx 收购相关无形资产摊销。
2022 年毛利 106.03 亿美元（2021: 79.29 亿），但计入 14.48 亿美元收购相关无形资产摊销于销售成本。
All Other 经营亏损 49.79 亿美元，主要含 35.48 亿美元收购相关无形资产摊销、10.81 亿美元股权激励费用、4.52 亿美元收购相关成本。
经营利润由 2021 年 36.48 亿美元降至 2022 年 12.64 亿美元；净利润由 31.62 亿降至 13.20 亿美元。

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — 风险因素：第三方晶圆代工依赖（供给约束的结构性表述）
